summary: Frontend-only testing of the new 2-step GRN flow on /admin/grn-approval (GrnApprovalPage.jsx). Used shipment Q7YA7Z (in_transit, vendor H1330, PO 28792, site P1/P2). All specified assertions passed: Step 1/Step 2 badges render, initial Post button disabled with correct 'Run Validate GRN first' tooltip, Validate button disabled without a Site with tooltip 'Select a Site first', mocked ok:false path opens grn-validation-error-box modal with the seeded issue rendered under grn-validation-issue-0 and OK button closes it (post remains disabled), mocked ok:true path flips button to 'Validated ✓' with success toast and unlocks Step 2 only AFTER Supplier Invoice Number + Bill Date are also filled, stale-invalidation useEffect correctly resets Validated state on both actualQtys change AND site change (Post re-disabled), Reject and Mark Discrepancy buttons remain visible, confirm dialog (grn-approval-confirm-dialog) opens with correct invoice number + formatted bill date and cancels cleanly (never actually posted to live SAP).
critical_code_review_comments: GrnApprovalPage.jsx is 2025 lines - consider splitting (tabs / detail dialog / validation into subcomponents). Not blocking.

useEffect deps [shipment?._id, siteId, actualQtys] uses an object identity for actualQtys - works fine because setActualQtys always returns a new object, but has eslint-disable; matches STO pattern shipped in iteration_190.
runGrnValidation passes warehouse_id (empty string via warehouseId state) - backend must accept empty string; confirmed working in this test.
seed_data_creation: None - reused existing in_transit shipment Q7YA7Z. NO real SAP post was executed (only opened + cancelled confirm dialog).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Q7YA7Z was still in_transit at end of test (never confirmed the Post GRN dialog). Site options are P1 and P2 (both selectable). Validation POST endpoint was intercepted via page.route in tests - live call was not exercised in the final pass, but the earlier run against real SAP also returned ok:true within ~1.5s. Bill Date is a shadcn Popover Calendar (button, not input) - open it and click a day (`button[name="day"]`) rather than .fill().
